eid.zh: 操纵持续存在的长枪，将敌人穿在枪上并继续旋转#枪尖实际移动越快，接触伤害越高#蓄力后松开攻击，向枪尖方向发动突刺
eid.en: Control a persistent spear, impale enemies, and keep them on the weapon as it rotates#Higher actual spear-tip speed deals more contact damage#Charge and release to thrust in the spear tip's direction

text.zh: 使用泰克罗完成里角色/特殊

eid.zh: 以长枪瞄准并蓄力，使枪尖延伸出在房间中镜像反射的光柱#松开攻击后沿光柱无敌冲刺，并伤害沿途附近的敌人
eid.en: Aim and charge the spear to project a beam from its tip that reflects across the room#Release to dash invincibly along the beam, damaging nearby enemies

description.zh: {{Speed}} 超额的吞噬物不再降低移速#每层均有小恶魔乞丐
description.en: {{Speed}} Excessive phagocytosis no longer reduces movement speed#There are rift beggars on each floor

eid.zh: 操控掌中黑洞吸收敌人与掉落物，并将捕获物重新发射#敌人被吸入后不会立即死亡#捕获物的种类、重量与蓄力会影响释放攻击
eid.en: Control a handheld black hole to capture enemies and pickups, then launch them as projectiles#Captured enemies remain alive inside the black hole#A capture's type, mass, and charge affect the released attack

text.zh: 使用安娜完成里角色/特殊

description.zh: 攻击时概率触发随机额外攻击
description.en: Trigger extra random attack forms when attack.

eid.zh: 用准星选择落点，以自身为武器发动高威力坠击#满蓄力后移动至准星上方，攻击落点附近的敌人#准星也决定攻击后的站位；攻击过程及结束后0.25秒内无敌
eid.en: Choose a landing point with the reticle and use annA herself as the weapon#At full charge, move above the reticle and crash down to attack nearby enemies#The reticle is also your final position; invincible during the attack and for 0.25s afterward

description.zh: {{Collectible:628}} 初始房间始终存在死亡证明传送门#每层可以额外自由选择一个被动道具#未拥有的被动道具最多可以拿两次
description.en: {{Collectible:628}} The initial room always has a death certificate teleportation door#Each layer can choose an additional passive item freely #Unowned passive items can be taken up to twice

eid.zh: 接触道具时不会直接获得，而是将其作为知识送入死亡证明#每层可永久取得知识对应的道具，或临时取得其附近的一项遐想#选择遐想不会消耗知识；下一层仍可重新选择#自动点亮死亡证明中存在可用知识的房间
eid.en: Touched items are not gained immediately; they are sent to Death Certificate as knowledge#Each floor, claim the item recorded as knowledge or temporarily realize a nearby reverie#Choosing a reverie does not consume its knowledge; it can be chosen again next floor#Automatically reveals Death Certificate rooms containing available knowledge

text.zh: 使用泽伊斯托斯完成里角色/特殊

eid.zh: 每层从控制中枢任命一名管理员，由其愚见改变世界的运行规则#不同管理员会依照自己的错误认知解释并管理游戏机制#引起管理员的兴趣，使其准备进一步改变规则的提案
eid.en: Appoint an administrator in the Control Hub each floor, whose Folly alters how the world operates#Each administrator interprets and manages game rules through their own mistaken reasoning#Draw their interest until they prepare a Proposal to reshape the rules further

Entering the first Boss room on each floor removes Charm; they become hostile again#Super Satan's room always removes Charm from all charmed enemies#Difficulty: Hard

eid.en: {{Player19}} Play as Jacob and Esau#!!! Both can only shoot toward each other#{{ArrowUp}} Tears that pass through the other character are boosted#Difficulty: Normal

eid.zh: {{Player21}} 里以撒开局#{{Item:Ember}} 持有8个余烬#!!! 除余烬外，所有被动道具效果无效#{{Item:Ember}} 余烬复制最近一次永久失去的被动道具#!!! 8个余烬不占用里以撒的道具槽#不可打开控制台#难度等级：噩梦

eid.zh: {{Player0}} 以撒开局#{{Collectible628}} 每层从死亡证明区域开始#!!! 越接近道具，道具轮换得越快#{{Collectible478}} 使用暂停可使所有道具停止轮换2秒#难度等级：简单
eid.en: {{Player0}} Play as Isaac#{{Collectible628}} Each floor starts in the Death Certificate area#!!! The closer you are to an item, the faster it rerolls#{{Collectible478}} Using Pause freezes all rerolls for 2 seconds#Difficulty: Easy

eid.zh: {{Player9}} 伊甸开局#!!! 受伤时随机3个被动道具从身上脱落#及时触碰可以重新拾取#!!! 敌人可以抢走脱落的道具并获得强化#击杀携带道具的敌人可重新取回道具#难度等级：普通
eid.en: {{Player9}} Play as Eden#!!! Taking damage knocks 3 random passive items out of you#Touch them to pick them back up#!!! Enemies can steal dropped items and become stronger#Kill the thief to recover the stolen item#Difficulty: Normal

eid.zh: {{Player24}} 里犹大开局#!!! 房间中的一切都会逐渐隐形#{{Collectible705}} 黑暗艺术经过的区域会暂时重新显形#!!! 没有{{TreasureRoom}}宝箱房与{{Shop}}商店#难度等级：简单
eid.en: {{Player24}} Play as Tainted Judas#!!! Everything in the room gradually turns invisible#{{Collectible705}} Dark Arts briefly reveals the area it passes through#!!! No {{TreasureRoom}}Treasure Rooms or {{Shop}}Shops#Difficulty: Easy

eid.en: {{Player6}} Play as Samson#{{Item:Cloundy}} Start with 5 Cloundies#{{Collectible583}} Start with Rocket in a Jar; bombs placed by Cloundies also become rockets#Difficulty: Hard

eid.en: {{Player15}} Play as Apollyon#!!! Cannot shoot tears#Click enemies with the mouse to deal damage#Difficulty: Normal

eid.zh: {{Player18}} 伯大尼开局#!!! 无法发射眼泪#蓄满专用充能后，朝攻击方向发出{{Item:Hyper_Velocity}}列车撞击敌人#难度等级：普通

eid.zh: 根据当前生命模仿一种可获得的心#优先抵消{{BrokenHeart}}碎心与{{RottenHeart}}腐心
eid.en: Imitates an obtainable heart based on your health#Priority: remove {{BrokenHeart}} Broken Hearts and {{RottenHeart}} Rotten Hearts

eid.zh: 根据当前生命模仿一种可获得的心（半颗）#优先抵消{{BrokenHeart}}碎心与{{RottenHeart}}腐心
eid.en: Imitates an obtainable heart based on your health (half)#Priority: remove {{BrokenHeart}} Broken Hearts and {{RottenHeart}} Rotten Hearts

eid.zh: 优先揭示未探索的{{TreasureRoom}}/{{Shop}}/{{BossRoom}}等特殊房（不含隐藏系）#没有则揭示最多3个普通房间
eid.en: Reveal an unexplored special room (Treasure/Shop/Boss; not secret)#If none, reveal up to 3 normal rooms

eid.zh: 下一次炸弹爆炸时清除本房间所有弹幕
eid.en: The next bomb explosion clears all projectiles in the room

eid.zh: 消耗富余的硬币/钥匙/炸弹，生成对应琉璃掉落#硬币>5、钥匙>1、炸弹>1才会计入#最多约3份#{{PoopPickup}} 没有可消耗资源时生成琉璃便便
eid.en: Convert surplus coins/keys/bombs into glazed pickups#Only coins>5, keys>1, bombs>1 count#Up to about 3#{{PoopPickup}} Spawns a glaze poop if nothing to convert

eid.zh: 下次使用普通主动时，返还一半消耗的充能（向上取整）
eid.en: Next normal active use refunds half the charges spent (rounded up)

eid.zh: 本层随机房间出现一把钥匙跟班，只能用它打开#地图会标出钥匙所在房间#给予数个琉璃掉落或一个重复道具
eid.en: A key familiar appears in a random room this floor#The key's room is marked on the map#Spawns glazed pickups or a duplicate item

eid.zh: 将队首便便复制到队列末尾#空队列时获得基础便便
eid.en: Copy the front poop spell to the end of the queue#Empty queue grants a basic poop

text.zh: 使用店主击败琉璃王子（普通）
text.en: Defeat Glaze Prince (Normal) as 店主

eid.zh: #缓缓吸引周围的掉落物#{{Coin}} 拾取：90%获得1枚硬币，10%获得5枚
eid.en: #Slowly attracts nearby pickups#{{Coin}} On pickup: 90% for 1 coin, 10% for 5

eid.zh: #{{Collectible}} 拾取后，将其中展示的道具记录为1份原型模块#原型模块存入蓝图仓库，可额外装配1次对应道具效果#只能作为模块使用，不能作为飞行器底座
eid.en: #{{Collectible}} On pickup, records the displayed item as 1 prototype module#Stored in Blueprint inventory, granting 1 extra installation of that item's effect#Modules only; cannot be used as a craft base

eid.zh: 赠予一份资源，换取下层祝福#靠近后左右切换馈赠，走进确认#按{{ButtonRT}}取消
eid.en: Offer a resource for a blessing on the next floor#Switch gifts with left/right, walk in to confirm#Press {{ButtonRT}} to cancel

eid.zh: 吞噬身边的基础掉落#每25个送出一个品质4道具，然后离开#每个偶数层出现
eid.en: Swallows nearby pickups#Every 25 pickups: a quality 4 item, then leaves#Appears on even floors

eid.zh: 从来日预支资源，再用未来偿还#靠近后左右切换契约，走进确认#按{{ButtonRT}}取消
eid.en: Borrow resources from tomorrow and repay them later#Switch contracts with left/right, walk in to confirm#Press {{ButtonRT}} to cancel

eid.zh: {{Heart}} 支付一半红心（下取整）#奖励随角色状态变化
eid.en: {{Heart}} Pay half your red hearts (floored)#Rewards change with the player

eid.zh: {{Coin}} 靠近后选择出售价格#碰触商人完成定价交易#按{{ButtonRT}}暂时取消
eid.en: {{Coin}} Choose a sale price nearby#Walk into the merchant to confirm the trade#Press {{ButtonRT}} to cancel temporarily
